prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1139; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Claimant reports being struck on the driver side by an insured vehicle that entered on a late yellow. Claimant is not represented by counsel. Initial contact made by phone, statement recorded, and photos of both vehicles requested.

Entry 2: Reviewed the police report. Responding officer noted the insured vehicle was cited for failure to yield. Scene diagram is consistent with the claimant's account. Liability appears clear pending the insured's recorded statement.

Entry 3: Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness beginning the following morning. Denies loss of consciousness and airbag deployment in the claimant's vehicle. Advised claimant of the medical payments coverage and asked for names of treating providers. Claimant states she has been seen at an urgent care clinic and will send records.

Entry 4: Received urgent care records. Diagnosis is cervical strain with muscle spasm, no fractures on imaging. Treatment plan calls for rest, over-the-counter pain relief, and a follow-up with a primary care physician in two weeks. Claimant was given a copy of the claim reference and our adjuster contact information. Reminded claimant that she may consult an attorney at any time and that she is free to make her own decisions about representation.

Entry 5: Claimant returned the signed medical authorization form. Requested prior records covering the past five years to rule out pre-existing neck conditions. Vehicle damage estimate is complete and has been sent to the repair shop. Reserve reviewed and set for the injury and property damage exposures. Next step is to follow up with the primary care provider once the two-week visit has taken place.
